tagline: Your AI chats, exported your way

slides.title: Export ChatGPT and Claude chats in one click
slides.text: Markdown, HTML, plain text, Obsidian, JSON or PDF, right from the chat. Or copy it as Markdown.

slides.title: Your whole history, one note per chat
slides.text: Drop the data export from ChatGPT or Claude. Every conversation becomes Markdown with its own dates, plus an index, in one zip.

slides.title: Export only the messages you need
slides.text: Tick them right in the chat, then pick the format. Your conversation stays as it is.

slides.title: One HTML file that opens anywhere
slides.text: Light and dark, styled code, a link to the original. No scripts, nothing loaded from the web.

slides.title: Continue in another AI
slides.text: Copy a ready hand-off prompt with a token count. All in your browser: no account, no server, no tracking.
